metadata.description: UE5/Houdini/HDK 셰이더·렌더링·시뮬레이션 작업용 Claude Code 플러그인 모음 (6개)

plugins.name: unreal-dev-kb
plugins.description: UE5 셰이더/렌더링/머티리얼/이펙트/디버깅 cvar/매크로/콘솔명령 약 2,000+ 카탈로그 (9개 영역). 협력: ue5-rdg(C++ API), ue5-shaders(HLSL 코드)

plugins.name: ue5-rdg
plugins.description: UE5 RDG C++ API 작성 패턴. FRDGBuilder/AddPass, Compute/Raster/Copy Pass, Scene View Extension, Resource 생명주기. 협력: unreal-dev-kb(cvar), ue5-shaders(HLSL)

plugins.name: ue5-shaders
plugins.description: UE 5.7.4+ Engine/Shaders HLSL 트리 라우터. Material translator, Vertex Factory, BasePass, Substrate BSDF, Lumen/Nanite/VSM/TSR HLSL 흐름. 협력: unreal-dev-kb(cvar), ue5-rdg(C++ API)

plugins.name: ue5-coding-convention
plugins.description: UE5 C++ 코딩 컨벤션 — 명명, 어설션(check/ensure), 타입(int32/uint8), 포맷, enum, RPC, 데이터 검증. 협력: ue5-rdg(렌더 코드), unreal-dev-kb(런타임 cvar)

plugins.name: gpu-fluid-sim
plugins.description: GPU Eulerian Fluid Simulation (Stable Fluids/Navier-Stokes) 알고리즘. UE5 Compute Shader/Niagara Grid, Houdini Gas OpenCL/Pyro 적용. 협력: ue5-rdg(UE 구현), hdk-reference(Houdini), unreal-dev-kb(Niagara cvar)

plugins.name: hdk-reference
plugins.description: Houdini 21.0 HDK C++ 레퍼런스. DSO entry points, SOP/DM/GUI/SIM/RAY/VEX/COP2/CHOP 패턴, custom primitive, viewport hooks, Mantra procedurals. 협력: gpu-fluid-sim(Pyro/Gas)
